pick.headline: Hajj stampede at Mina kills about 270 pilgrims
pick.fbis: The Near East & South Asia Daily Report of May 24, 1994, carried Riyadh SPA counting 829 Hajj deaths, including at that day's crowded stoning ritual at Mina, and Paris AFP citing witnesses to a stampede that killed dozens.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Near East & South Asia, No. 100, 24 May 1994
evidence.snippet: …ore Than 800 Lives in 12 ys LD2305235394 Riyadh SPA in Arabic 2225 GMT 23 May 94 [Text] Jeddah, 23 May, (SPA)}—An authoritative source at the Ministry of Health announced today the following: After the conclusion of the Hajj rites by the pilgrims of God’s holy shrine and their departure from Mina to holy Mecca for their homebound journey and, after having taken note of the daily statements on the number of those who have suffered sun stroke…
